metadata.title: Cellular protein degradation: DC50
metadata.note: Raw author and database records are retained. Author CSV structure extraction is not an independent redraw of all structures. Exposure uncertainty is disclosed and is not replaced with guessed timing.

M001.context: KRAS G12D-HiBiT knock-in HEK293 cells; Nano-Glo HiBiT lytic detection; DC50. The series method reports 24-48 h treatment without assigning a duration to each compound.
M001.context_evidence: Author CSV and original main-paper section KRAS G12D, G12V, G12C HiBiT assay; no substitution of viability-cell conditions.
